author: BenDooley7
body:
Welp, I have decided to retire from the staff team after almost 9 months of service. My life is going to be really busy when school starts and I know that I will have to time to do my part as a moderator during that time. I'll be on every once and a while, and I'll make sure to say hi to you guys when I get on. I'm looking forward to be able to play freely when I do play! Thanks so much for being so good to me while I was moderating. 

~kthxbai
